description: Curated bonus issues of NSE-listed Indian companies (2022 onwards) used by scripts/holdings_review.py. Yahoo records a bonus as a split (a 1:1 bonus appears as a 2-for-1 split); when a Yahoo split event matches an entry here (same symbol, date within a few days of the ex-date or record date, same share ratio) it is treated as a bonus: the new shares are a separate nil-cost lot dated from the allotment date (or the record date when the allotment date is null). ratio is Indian terms: new_shares for every per_held_shares held. split_before_bonus, when present, is a stock split on the same record date applied before the bonus (the bonus ratio counts post-split shares). Add entries only from the company's or the exchange's own announcement; never estimate dates.
